pieces.Text: Drow gain the following spell-like abilities. The caster level for these effects is equal to the drow's level. At will-dancing lights, detect magic. In addition, drow count as having the Minor Psychic Power feat for the purpose of meeting prerequisites, and if a drow takes the Psychic Power feat, she can add the drow noble's limning light supernatural ability to the list of spell-like abilities available to her.
